newsitem.title: EU: Official Journal contents - OJ C 36 of February 5, 1997.
newsitem.headline: Official Journal contents - OJ C 36 of February 5, 1997.

text.p: (Note - contents are displayed in reverse order to that in the printed Journal)
Notice of the impending expiry of certain anti-dumping measures (97/C 36/11)
Prior notification of a concentration (Case No IV/M.869 - BGT/EHG-AIM) (97/C 36/10)
COUNCIL DECISION of 20 January 1997 appointing a member of the Advisory Committee on the Training of Midwives (97/C 36/07)
COUNCIL DECISION of 20 January 1997 appointing a member of the Advisory Committee on Pharmaceutical Training (97/C 36/06)
COUNCIL DECISION of 20 January 1997 appointing an alternate member of the Advisory Committee on the Training of Dental Practitioners (97/C 36/05)
COUNCIL RESOLUTION of 20 January 1997 on the integration of cultural aspects into Community actions (97/C 36/04)
COUNCIL DECISION of 20 January 1997 appointing the Vice-President of the Community Plant Variety Office (97/C 36/03)
